# Font Awesome Free 6.5.2 (bundled)

These files are redistributed from **Font Awesome Free**, © Fonticons, Inc.

- Icons (`.woff2` fonts): **CC BY 4.0** — <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>
- Fonts: **SIL OFL 1.1** — <https://scripts.sil.org/OFL>
- Code (`all.min.css`): **MIT** — <https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT>

Full license: <https://fontawesome.com/license/free>

Contents:
- `css/all.min.css` — the `truetype` `src` entries were stripped; only `woff2`
  is served (supported by every browser since ~2016).
- `webfonts/*.woff2` — solid, regular, brands, and the v4 compatibility face.

To update: replace these files with a newer Free release from
<https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/releases> (or cdnjs) and re-run the
`truetype`-strip step, or switch to `fontawesome.source: cdn` in `_config.yml`.
